title: Ripple (Grateful Dead) – Easy Guitar Lesson + Intro Riff
description:
In this campfire guitar lesson from Pete’s Campfire Songbook, I’ll show you how to play Ripple by the Grateful Dead in a simple, easy-to-follow way.

This is a beautiful, laid-back song that works perfectly in a campfire or acoustic setting, and we’ll keep things accessible while still capturing its feel.

In this lesson you'll learn:
• The chords you need for the song
• A gentle strumming pattern to suit the vibe
• The opening riff, made simple and playable

It’s a short and relaxed lesson, ideal for anyone looking to add a timeless, mellow song to their repertoire.

If you enjoy easy, singalong-friendly guitar lessons, be sure to subscribe to Pete’s Campfire Songbook for more songs you can play anywhere.

Thanks for watching and happy strumming!

So it sounds like this With the gold of sunshine, and my tunes simply on the harp unstrung? Would you hear my voice Coming through the music Would you hold it near As if it were your own So we do two verses and then we get to the chorus. In the chorus, we need an A minor and a D a G and a C You also need an A and it ends on a D so it sounds like this Ptripple, in still water, where there is no pebble tarns, no wind to blow So here it gets 1 2 3 4 D one, two, three, four, one, two, three, four then we have another two verses and another chorus and then we finish up another two verses. There's a really nice intro which you can also use as an instrumental in the song You can play the song without it, though. But it's a nice intro so let's let's learn it. With the gold of sunshine is this note here. So that's Thrill Run. So we need that bit as a key bit, and then the 2nd bit We're playing our G and we're hitting this 2nd string That's open and then on the 3rd string the 2nd fret and open and then you put the C down and it completes that riff and then the rest of the riff is kind of on the third string So lets just do that again I'm not a fool, I'm a fool I'm a fool, I'm a fool I'm a fool, I'm a fool I'm a fool, I'm a fool I'm a fool, I'm a fool I'm a fool, I'm a fool I'm a fool, I'm a fool I'm a fool, I'm a fool I'm a fool, I'm a fool I'm a fool, I'm a fool I'm a fool, I'm a fool I'm a fool, I'm a fool I'm a fool, I'm a fool I'm a fool, I'm a fool Where there is no pebble tar No wind to blow
